facts.fact: Government decree no. 2021-3 of 6 January 2021, issued by the Head of Government after deliberation of the Council of Ministers, organises the publication of public data under the open-by-default principle for public bodies; the document states no end or replacement.
facts.system: Décret gouvernemental n° 2021-3 relatif aux données publiques ouvertes

facts.fact: The decree makes the e-Government Unit of the Presidency of the Government administer the national open data portal and requires public bodies to publish their datasets on it (art. 4 and 9), so the portal is tied to the decree; the document does not report the portal as running or any body as having published.
facts.system: National open data portal (portail national des données ouvertes)

systems.tiers: national; public bodies under art. 2 of organic law 2016-22
